# Edge-case fixtures

Generated by `cargo run -p gen_fixture -- edge`. Don't edit by hand; change `tools/gen_fixture/src/edge.rs` and regenerate.

Each file targets one area of reader behaviour. The expected output is whatever OpenSpout (through sheet-stream's normalisation) produces; see the parity tests.

| File | Covers |
|---|---|
| `cell-types.xlsx` | One value per row covering every cell type (`s`, `inlineStr`, `n`, `b`, `e`, `str`, `d`), int-vs-float edge cases, blanks and an unparseable number. |
| `layout.xlsx` | Sheet `Layout`: column gaps, cells/rows without `r`, missing and empty rows, trailing blanks, a `<dimension>` wider than the data. Sheet `Strings`: shared-string decoding (rich text, phonetic runs, `xml:space`, `_xHHHH_` escapes, entities, unicode). |
| `dates.xlsx` | Rows = number formats (built-in date IDs 14–22 and 45–47, custom date/time codes, and non-date look-alikes such as `[Red]0.00` and `"y"0`). Columns = serial values including the 1900 leap-year bug around serial 60 and time-only fractions. |
| `dates-1904.xlsx` | Workbook with `date1904="1"`. Same serials formatted as date (B), datetime (C) and General (D). |
| `formulas.xlsx` | Formula cells with numeric, string, bool, error, date-formatted and missing cached values, plus shared (`t="shared"`, children have no formula text) and array formulas. |
| `multi-sheet.xlsx` | Four sheets whose workbook order differs from part numbers and relationship ids; an absolute relationship target, a non-standard part path, a name needing XML escaping, a self-closing empty `<sheetData/>`, and no shared-strings part. |
| `date-formats.xlsx` | Rendering of date, time and duration format codes (`dates => 'formatted'`): 12/24-hour, day and month names, quoted and escaped literals, locale prefixes, `[Red]`-style brackets (whose letters OpenSpout treats as format characters), CJK literals, every duration shape, and negative values. |
| `quirks.csv` | fgetcsv edge cases: blank lines, CRLF, doubled quotes, multi-line fields, whitespace before quotes, text after quotes, `=` text, a bare CR, empty fields. |
| `semicolon-bom.csv` | UTF-8 BOM and a `;` delimiter (read with `csv.delimiter = ';'`). |
| `unterminated.csv` | An unterminated quote: the field runs to end of file. |
| `no-final-newline.csv` | No newline after the last record. |
| `latin1-bytes.csv` | Invalid UTF-8 (Latin-1 bytes), passed through unchanged as with OpenSpout's UTF-8 default. |
| `cr-only.csv` | Old Mac line endings: a bare CR is not a line break for fgetcsv, so this is one record. |
| `tabs.tsv` | Tab-separated, with a quoted tab (read with `csv.delimiter = "\t"`). |
